name: dsh-literature-standalone
description: Standalone repository for the @shlv/dsh-literature-core family: the literature research capability seam (dblp + arXiv) plus its model-facing tools. Host dependencies (@deepseek-ai/dsh-*, cordis, schemastery) resolve through npm; the four literature packages link as a local workspace.

scripts.build: tsc -p literature/tsconfig.json && tsc -p literature-dblp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p literature-arxiv/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tool-literature/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p literature/tsconfig.json && tsc -p literature-dblp/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p literature-arxiv/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tool-literature/tsconfig.json --noEmit
